finding: Thbs4-/- mice show larger tendon collagen fibrils, smaller soleus, decreased grip strength and LPL activity.
limitation: Global knockout; developmental vs acute roles not separable

finding: Thbs4 stabilizes sarcolemma via dystrophin-glycoprotein and integrin complex trafficking; loss worsens dystrophy.
Spatial transcriptomics shows Thbs4 upregulated specifically in fibrotic regions of dystrophic mouse muscle.
limitation: Correlation in two DMD models; no functional test

finding: THBS4 identified as myokine hub upregulated after untrained eccentric running in human muscle.
limitation: Acute untrained state; small human cohort

finding: THBS4 upregulated in pulmonary arteries of PH models and patients, driving PASMC remodeling via TGF-β1/SMAD2/HIF-1α.
limitation: Primarily rat PH models; human correlative only

finding: THBS4 upregulated in irreversible PAH-CHD and promotes PASMC proliferation, migration and phenotype switching.
limitation: Single rat model; limited human samples

finding: Thbs4 requires secretory pathway transit to stabilize cardiomyocyte sarcolemma; deletion worsens mdx cardiomyopathy.
limitation: Engineered secretion-defective model; in vitro overexpression

finding: TGF-β1 induces endothelial THBS4 via SMAD3, mediating pro-angiogenic effects in vitro and in vivo.
Thbs4 T3R and TSP-C domains bind BiP and Atf6α, activating adaptive ER stress response in cardiomyocytes.
THBS4 mRNA upregulated ~62-fold during tenogenic differentiation of human muscle-derived cells in vitro.
limitation: In vitro induction; no loss-of-function testing

finding: Murine Thbs4 mapped to chromosome 13; human THBS4 to 5q13, with muscle/bone-related promoter features.
limitation: Genomic mapping only; predates functional work
